designSource.htmlTitle: SUBLIMINAL STUDIO v8.0.32 — Deep Integration · Encode + Install

slides.label: Normal Carrier Volume 0 dB
slides.note: Static carrier copy · no movement. 0 dB = matched-baseline ceiling; move left only to make it quieter.

slides.label: Secondary · Affirmation 1 (A) Volume 0.0 dB
slides.note: 0 dB = matched-baseline ceiling; move left only to make Affirmation 1 (A) quieter.

slides.label: Primary · Affirmation 1 Volume 0.0 dB
slides.note: 0 dB = matched-baseline ceiling; move left only to make Affirmation 1 quieter.

slides.label: Standard · Primary ↔ Secondary
slides.note: Less = lower amount · More = higher amount.

slides.label: Master 1 · Carrier ↔ Both Affirmations
slides.note: Less = lower amount · More = higher amount.

slides.label: Master Audio Volume · Final Output
slides.note: Less = lower amount · More = higher amount.

slides.label: 8D Carrier Volume −60.0 dB
slides.note: Same uploaded Carrier file · independent 8D branch volume.

slides.label: High-Pass OFF
slides.note: Optional low-rumble cleanup. OFF keeps the uploaded Carrier unchanged.

slides.label: Low-Pass OFF
slides.note: Optional high-frequency softening. OFF keeps the uploaded Carrier unchanged.

slides.label: Stereo Width 100%
slides.note: 100% = original stereo · 0% = mono · above 100% widens only the Normal Carrier branch.

slides.label: Fade In 0s
slides.note: Session-start Carrier fade only. 0 seconds keeps the existing immediate start.

slides.label: 8D Rotation Speed 25%
slides.note: Width and rotation speed are independent. Neither changes the 8D branch volume.

slides.label: Binaural Volume 0.0 dB
slides.note: 0 dB = neutral binaural level, matching the other source controls. This trim changes only the generated tone pair and remains independent of Master 1 and Master 2.

slides.label: Beat Frequency 10.0 Hz
slides.note: This is the difference between the left-ear and right-ear tones.

slides.label: Center Tone 400 Hz
slides.note: Audible midpoint. The app places one tone below it and one equally above it.

slides.label: Rhythmic Volume 0.0 dB
slides.note: 0 dB = neutral generated-tone level. This engine is independent of both Master Balance sliders.

slides.label: Pulse Frequency 6.0 Hz
slides.note: How many amplitude pulses occur each second. Delta and Theta buttons set this same pulse-frequency control; the band label is informational only.

slides.label: Tone Frequency 400 Hz
slides.note: The audible pitch being pulsed. This is separate from the pulse frequency.

slides.label: Pulse Depth 100%
slides.note: 100% = full modulation depth. 0% = a constant tone with no rhythmic pulsing.

slides.label: Secondary Speed 1.00x
slides.note: When ON, this is the Secondary-only speed. When OFF, it follows Primary exactly.

slides.label: Speed 1.00x
slides.note: Primary speed. Secondary uses this same speed whenever Secondary Preset Modification is OFF.

slides.label: Layer Volume 0.0 dB
slides.note: One shared attenuation-only layer trim. It remains identical for both affirmation streams even when Secondary modification is ON.

slides.label: Speed 0.85x
slides.note: Less = slower speech · More = faster speech.

slides.label: Pitch 0.90
slides.note: Less = deeper voice · More = higher voice.

slides.label: Volume 1.0
slides.note: Less = quieter voice · More = louder voice.

slides.label: Stability 0.50
slides.note: Less = more expressive · More = more consistent.

slides.label: Similarity 0.75
slides.note: Less = looser voice match · More = closer voice match.
